en.title: Robot Matrix Commands
en.description: Execute row/column swaps, reversals, and clockwise rotations in order. Coordinates use 0-based indices.
en.input: r c; then r lines of the matrix; then q; then q lines of commands. A command is `swapRows r1 r2`, `swapColumns c1 c2`, `reverseRow r`, `reverseColumn c`, or `rotate90Clockwise`. The matrix must be square when it is rotated. Site supplement: r,c≤50, q≤500.
en.output: Output the final matrix, one row per line, with values separated by spaces.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Process the operations one by one according to the definitions, and watch the boundaries.
